title: In the park
description: Name what is in a park, and talk about the small things there.
grammar: gender and articles, and the plural of nouns
grammarNote: The nouns in a park are mostly small ones, and most are feminine.

explanation.summary: A park is full of small nouns: swings, paths, ants. They follow the usual rules, and the plural is where most of the interest is.

sections.heading: The nouns
sections.body: La brisa, la mariposa, la hormiga, la sombra and la hoja are feminine. El columpio, el tobogán, el paseo, el nido and el sendero are masculine. El paseo is the walk itself, and el sendero is the path through the park.

sections.heading: A park full of plurals
sections.body: The plural adds -s or -es: las mariposas, los columpios, las hormigas. Two of these words are a little different: el paseo becomes los paseos, and el tobogán becomes los toboganes, because the -án keeps its accent in the singular and drops it in the plural.

items.note: Masculine: el columpio. The plural is los columpios.
Masculine: el tobogán. The plural drops the accent: los toboganes.

drills.meaning: the nest is in the tree

drills.note: Hormiga is feminine, so las hormigas.
